business_summary: Kufu Company Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the daily life related and life events related businesses. It offers Flyer and shopping information service; personal household accounting service; website to collect tips for feeding young children; a website for household accounts; and travel and outing media activities. The company also provides R+house; Ouchino, an information site for buying and selling real estate and housing information; Ouchino Class Match, a real estate sales support tool; Kufuietate, a housing information media; Ingenious Ietate Counter, a housing consultation and housing company introduction service; Anymari; Everyone's Wedding, a wedding information media; DRESS EVERY that sells imported dresses; MY FAVORITE PART, which produces resort weddings; Dear, a wedding online invitation service; Everyone's Events, a party venue search site for corporations and organizations; and TIG DRESS, a wedding dress rental shop. In addition, the company engages in investment-related businesses; real estate brokerage services; operation of WOMO, a local media outlet and social experience app for children; NinjaPark, a sports-type amusement facility; and provision of local information media. The company was formerly known as Kufu Company Inc. and changed its name to Kufu Company Holdings Inc. in December 2024. Kufu Company Holdings Inc. was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
